title: OVA
overview: After recounting a dream to Hanayo, Maki meets a little girl that suddenly appears in the music room. The next day, Maki is absent from school, and the other girls decide to visit her. However, Eli returns to the school to pick up a textbook and ends up following a mysterious shadow. As the gap between dreams and reality closes, an amazing encounter awaits her and the other members of µ's.
